opportunities.title: International Payroll Analyst
opportunities.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Analyst to own and scale our international payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

  • International Payroll Execution & Oversight: 
    • Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.
    • Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.
    • Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.
  • Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee international equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.
  • Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.
  • Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.
  • Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).
  • Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ y

You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop. This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation. Your Responsibilities: Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes. GHG reduction calculation : Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes Policy Fit : asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation. Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities. Your profile You recognize yourself in the following: Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship) Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. At SkyNRG, you’ll find: An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF What we offer We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet. Besides that, we offer: A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation. An inspiring international work environment in a fast-growing and innovative industry. opportunities.title: Working Student - Procurement
opportunities.description: 📍 Location: Amsterdam ⏱ Weekly Hours: Between 16 -30 hours per week 📅 Start Date & Duration: Available immediately (6-month minimum commitment) Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! Since 2012, Fastned has been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations powered entirely by solar and wind energy — now spanning over 400 stations across nine countries in Europe. Our goal is 1,000 stations in prime locations. About the role We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Working Student with a strong passion for data, analytics and procurement . In this role, you will play a key part and help build the foundations of Procurement at Fastned. In this role, you will be part of the Procurement Team, reporting to the Head of Procurement and collaborating closely with the Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams spanning Construction, Operations, Technology & Engineering, and IT. Procurement at Fastned is designed to support the business, not constrain it. The Procurement function does not make unilateral decisions about supplier or product selection. Instead, it brings structure, market insight, commercial expertise and oversight. You will help put this approach into practice. What you’ll be doing Dive into our supplier and purchasing data to uncover spending patterns, spot smart consolidation opportunities, and identify potential savings. Research market developments, map out supplier landscapes, and benchmark pricing and services across Fastned’s key procurement categories. Help set the team up for success in commercial negotiations by preparing clear supplier profiles, spend insights, and negotiation briefs. Keep track of how our suppliers are performing across cost, quality, delivery, and ESG—helping prepare supplier reviews and following up on agreed next steps. Help build and maintain practical procurement templates, guidelines, and sourcing documentation that make buying at Fastned smooth and transparent. Support our Procurement Champions across different teams by sharing handy tools, templates, and everyday guidance. Coordinate meetings and workshops with internal teams and suppliers, making sure decisions and follow-up actions are clearly captured. Who we are looking for You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme (ideally in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field) with a genuine interest in procurement, supplier management, or commercial negotiations. You enjoy diving into data, spreadsheets, and complex information to turn them into clear, actionable insights. You’re confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with data visualisation or procurement tools is a great plus. You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and work well independently, while handling sensitive commercial and financial information with discretion. You communicate clearly and enjoy partnering with stakeholders across different teams and backgrounds. Fluency in English is essential, and any additional European language is a bonus. You’re excited about Fastned’s mission and eager to play an active part in accelerating the energy transition. What you’ll learn In this role, you will gain practical experience in: Procurement category management and strategic sourcing Supplier and contract management Spend analysis, RFP and tender processes Commercial negotiations Procurement governance and stakeholder management Building a new Procurement function in a fast-growing international company What you get out of it Beyond a meaningful working student role at a company actively accelerating Europe's energy transition, here's what we offer: Flexibility that fits your schedule .
